page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Right margin: fragments of a note column, cut off by the scan edge, beside the paragraph IV.

main_text.p: pericula contemnentis adfuisset, hoft-umqve obstitislet conatibus ; siqviden tanto impetu, ac tam impavido anim[?] in hostem irruit dexterum cornu, qvod ex qvinq; Maronitarum millibus consta-bat, ut illum non modò fuderit ac in tur-pissimam converterit fugam, verùm e-tiam Turcarum octodecim millia ferro interemerit, gloriosissimâ suo Principi partâ victoriâ ; sed hæc nostrum sunt præter institutum, ac aliud tempus, ali-um locum, aliudqve otium reqvirunt; tandem ut ad rem nostram redeam, Mel-chitæ nunc differunt à Maronitis in iis omnibus dogmatibus, in qvibus diffe-runt Græci à Latinis.

IV. Paucis scire velis, qvid censeo de Originibus Alexandrini à Seldeno editis[illegible, ~1 letter] n te ce Al run co, ne A, & Commentariis illustratis? Respondeo Seldenū plura admisisse in iis Originibus peccata cūm vertendo qvàm commen-tando; in versione ad suas adstruendas fal-lacias &propositaargumenta pro univer-salibus particularia interpretatus est, & vice versa; exemplo nunc esto.Eutychius loquens de Ordinationibus Demetrii ait,

page.notes: Right margin: only cut-off fragments of a note column remain at the scan edge, so the note text is illegible. Probable printing spelling as printed: "&propositaargumenta" (the scan shows a faint gap, which may be a space). Final line "loquens de Ordinationibus Demetrii ait," is in heavy type, possibly from damaged ink, and the first word "loquens" is partly uncertain. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Left-edge hyphen after "hoft" is unclear: the scan shows a mark that may be a hyphen or damage, and the word "hostiumqve" is not fully legible.
